profile_text.body:
PyTorch Image Models, known as timm, is an open-source project hosted on GitHub at huggingface/pytorch-image-models. It describes itself as the largest collection of PyTorch image encoders and backbones, and it ships training, evaluation, inference and export scripts along with pretrained weights. The model families it lists include ResNet, ResNeXT, EfficientNet, NFNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), MobileNetV4, MobileNet-V3 and V2, RegNet, DPN, CSPNet, Swin Transformer, MaxViT, CoAtNet and ConvNeXt. The project states that all model architecture families include variants with pretrained weights, and that some variants ship without weights by design.

Recent work described on the site includes Sapiens2 ViTs with EVA and NaFlexViT support, EUPE ViT (DINOv3-style) and ConvNeXt models, CSATV2, EfficientNet-X and EfficientNet-H B5 weights, and DINOv3 ConvNeXt and ViT models. ROPE support was added to NaFlexViT, and Naver ROPE-ViT is supported in eva.py. Existing ViT models can be loaded into NaFlexViT by passing use_naflex=True at model creation. Other changes include a local-dir pretrained schema for loading models and weights from a local folder, separate Hugging Face Hub instances for OpenCLIP and JAX weights that previously used load time remapping, and a dynamic global pool that selects among average pooling, max pooling, average plus max, or concatenation of average and max at model creation. Contributions are credited to named individuals including Yonghye Kwon and the GitHub user gusdlf93.

The project is recorded as a non-profit open-source foundation founded in 2019. No litigation, no tracked products and no MCP servers are associated with it in the available record.
